subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘SHAKE’ is written as ‘HKSAE’ , ‘RIVER’ is written as ‘RRVEI’, how will ‘OCEAN’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : First consonants and then vowels are arranged in ascending order according to English alphabetic series respectively.

So,

 
• ‘SHAKE’ is written as ‘HKSAE’ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd55bfa9505d7141cc2a39caa3dc58b67326faec17cc6951747601dfb4bb4f65.png] ​

And,

 
• ‘RIVER’ is written as ‘RRVEI’ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2274c62786873aaff51dbe3b26d2ba1c07f82009c5d9db70646220e2e04946e0.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘OCEAN’ will be written as : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7601b62bed8ae88a7ee1d10b120d092b7bcf499d5608666ad380d7a8fa64574.png] 

​

​Hence, "**CNAEO**" is the correct answer.
